name: POST /api/admin/voice-agent/calls/:call_id/credential-degraded - Record a mid-call provider failover and emit voice.credential.degraded.v1
description: OPERATOR route (x-admin-ops-token = ADMIN_OPS_TOKEN), called by the voice runtime once per degradation: a 429 or 5xx (or unreachable, status 0) from a layer's primary provider switches that layer to the stack's secondary at the next turn and emits voice.credential.degraded.v1 (3a853d10-54c6-4c94-9715-3655646d2a33#AC1). Body: layer (stt | llm_fast | llm_complex | tts, required), binding_id (uuid of the failing primary credential binding, required), provider (required), status (HTTP status 0-599, required), error (provider error text, <= 300 chars kept), switched_to_binding_id (uuid of the secondary, or null when the stack has none), switched_to_provider. The record is appended to the call's context.degraded[] and voice.credential.degraded.v1 is emitted to the tenant's audit chain with the binding ids and providers — never the key. 200 { call_id, layer, binding_id, provider, status, switched, switched_to_binding_id, switched_to_provider, at }. Errors: bad layer / binding_id / provider / status 400; unknown call 404; missing/wrong ops token 401/403.

testCases.name: The fast LLM's primary answered 429 -> switched to the secondary, recorded and emitted
400 - layer must be one of stt, llm_fast, llm_complex, tts

errorCases.message: layer must be one of stt, llm_fast, llm_complex, tts
errorCases.when: bad layer, binding_id not a uuid, missing provider, or status outside 0-599
